lead_raw_text:
The structure of MnCd3Ag crystallizes in the cubic space group F-43m (No. 216), with a unit cell containing 20 atoms—Mn4 Cd12 Ag4—distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows all Ag, Cd, and Mn centers adopt a close-packed-like local arrangement with 12 geometric neighbors per center atom; Cd is coordinated by 8 Cd, 2 Ag, and 2 Mn neighbors, while Ag and Mn each have 12 Cd neighbors. The geometric neighbor graph is fully connected in three dimensions across all 20 sites, and validated polyhedron contacts reveal corner-, edge-, and face-sharing among 12-vertex Cd polyhedra, as well as edge-sharing between Ag and Mn polyhedra.
